##### Project general facts

Tierra Viva is a limited collection of super-luxury mansions developed by DarGlobal in collaboration with Automobili Lamborghini, marking the design house's first residential architecture partnership of this kind. The collection is built around four distinct mansion types — the Esmeralda, Diamante, Painite, and Zafiro — spanning two to four levels each, with configurations ranging from four to six bedrooms. Each mansion draws its architectural language from Lamborghini's design identity, translating automotive precision into sculptural, angular forms. The project is positioned as a rare proposition for a discerning international clientele seeking a fusion of automotive heritage and residential architecture.

Residents have access to a dedicated clubhouse arranged over three levels, featuring a fully-equipped gym, sauna, steam room, hammam, and jacuzzis, alongside an adults' pool, kids' pool, sunken lounge, and terrace. The clubhouse also houses an owner's lounge, a car showroom space, a children's play area, and the Lamborghini Café, described as the brand's first café concept. Outdoor sun-lounger decks, a dedicated cooling pool system, a spa, and the Velocity Bar & Lounge complete the shared amenities offering.

Interiors are finished with local marble flooring in the foyer, living, and dining areas, and porcelain marble-look surfaces from Cosentino or Inalco in bedrooms, bathrooms, and basement areas, with plastered walls and gypsum ceilings throughout. Kitchens are fitted with engineered-stone countertops and built-in Miele appliances, including a fridge, oven, hob, hood, and dishwasher, while bathrooms are equipped with sanitary fixtures from Duravit, hansgrohe, and Gessi. Select mansions include a private car lift and a passenger elevator, with Aerothermia heating and cooling systems from Daikin or Vaillant, and each residence includes a basement-level home theatre and multipurpose room. The residences are delivered kitchen-equipped only, with carpets, furniture, and electronics available as a separate provision.


##### Location description and benefits


Benahavís is one of the most prestigious and picturesque locations on the Costa del Sol, known for its natural beauty, exclusivity, and elevated lifestyle. Nestled between the mountains and just a short drive from Marbella and Puerto Banús, it offers a perfect balance of privacy and accessibility. The area is famous for its panoramic sea and golf views, creating a serene residential atmosphere away from the busy coastline.

Surrounded by lush greenery and rolling hills, Benahavís is often referred to as one of the most desirable residential enclaves in southern Spain. It is home to a collection of luxury gated communities, world-class golf resorts, and fine dining restaurants, making it especially attractive for high-end living and investment. The municipality is also known for its strong infrastructure, safety, and a refined, low-density environment that enhances its exclusivity.

Despite its tranquil setting, Benahavís enjoys excellent connectivity to key destinations, including Málaga and its international airport. Residents benefit from proximity to beaches, international schools, shopping destinations, and leisure attractions, while still enjoying a peaceful, nature-oriented lifestyle that defines the essence of Costa del Sol living.
